reason: I don't pay anyone before the thing is in my hand, and here I have to send the item price and fee up front to a new page I've never heard of. I'd rather go to Shorja and pay cash for something close enough.
objection: Paying first by Zain Cash to a brand new service, then waiting 2 to 3 weeks or more. If it never shows up, who do I complain to? I've seen people lose money like this.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, or a friend I trust ordering from them a few times and actually getting his stuff on time.
